facts.text: Central College guarantees on-time graduation, pledging to cover an extra semester of tuition if a student has to take one.

sources.title: Central Way | Admission
sources.quote: At Central, we guarantee that you'll graduate on time! In fact, we are so dedicated to ensuring that you finish on time that we'll cover an extra semester if you have to take one.
